process_type: Metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) under atomic-layer epitaxy (ALE) mode
summary: ZnSe/ZnS quantum dots were grown in the Stranski–Krastanov mode using MOCVD in the ALE mode. The study investigated temperature-dependent photoluminescence (PL) behavior, revealing carrier transfer through the wetting layer and anomalous PL linewidth narrowing with increasing temperature.
evidence: The samples were grown on GaAs substrates using an atmospheric pressure MOCVD technique in the atomic-layer epitaxy (ALE) mode. The ZnSe QDs were formed by alternating supply of DMZn and H2Se precursors. Temperature-dependent PL measurements showed a redshift of the emission peak energy and linewidth narrowing, attributed to carrier transfer through the wetting layer.
